name: io.github.odience-network/thunderbird-cli-enhanced
description: Give AI agents full read/write email access via Mozilla Thunderbird. Zero credentials.

environmentVariables.name: TB_BRIDGE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname of the tb-bridge (default: 127.0.0.1). Set to host.docker.internal when running inside a container.

environmentVariables.name: TB_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token, required only if the bridge was started with TB_AUTH_TOKEN.
